text_block_list.text: The day of the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: There's a lot of promising Umamusume here again this year, but the one I'm most curious about has gotta be Dream Journey...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She called herself a follower of Stay Gold, but...
Taking on a GⅠ so soon, that's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text: —Honestly, don't you think her body still looks underdeveloped? She's noticeably smaller than any of the other runners, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you can't judge by appearances.
She was incredible back in her debut race too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...I briefly looked over the reactions on social media,
and it seems I'm getting far more attention than expected."

I was certain that Dream Journey's condition today
was worthy of capturing the entire crowd's attention.

Having watched her work so hard from up close,
I told her it was only natural she received such praise, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you very much.

"...Dream Journey remained
completely and utterly calm."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It seems it is about time.

So much so that it's hard to believe
she's an Umamusume running in her very first GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. What is it?
choice_data_list: Congrats on making it to a GⅠ. Give it your all today!!
Congrats on making it to a GⅠ. Do your best today!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations to you too,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I will give it my all today
so that I can run a race worthy of
being your very first GⅠ Umamusume."

...I said what needed to be said,
sharing my honest feelings right now.
Dream Journey answered that call as well. And yet—
...Why, I wonder.

I found myself still feeling
an invisible distance between us—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, here comes Dream Journey!
Looks pretty composed...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't feel like she's intimidated, does it?
Or rather, isn't she almost too quiet...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(So this is the atmosphere of a GⅠ...
The intimidating presence of the competing Umamusume is staggering...—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's see if cirrocumulus clouds are visible or not—
